description: Lists a site's saved versions, newest first - version_id, why it was saved, its label, whether an AI edit made it (ai: true), and when. Every edit_section and set_theme call saves the page first, so any AI edit can be undone with restore_version. A version labelled "AI edit: X" holds the page as it was BEFORE X ran. Version ids are reused once a page has 20 versions, so an id can later hold different content; order is by time, not by id. Free, and no account is needed for a draft you created.

draft_token.description: The draft token returned by draft_create, if you are working on an anonymous draft. Only needed when your client cannot send the x-pagetool-draft-token header.

page.description: Which page of the site, as its path ("/about", "/contact"). Omit for the home page. See list_pages.

site_key.description: The site whose undo history to list. Defaults to the caller's current draft site when omitted.

name: list_versions
title: List a site's undo history
